observations: Long red-brick SDAC wing with broad lower-level storefront glazing
Two upper facade levels use vertically proportioned windows grouped as both singles and pairs
Light horizontal masonry/metal bands divide the levels
Rounded glazed lobby is at the east end of the south frontage, beside Mackey Arena
photo_sources.model_mapping: South-east lobby moved to the east end of the south facade (local X about 52.5 m); upper windows alternate single and paired openings; ground glazing enlarged; pale course and low base added.
photo_sources.limits: Oblique published photo; no calibrated elevation or individual bay dimensions.

observations: Interior stair is visible through the curtain wall

photo_sources.model_mapping: A two-storey segmented curtain wall, visible two-flight stair, and south-facing paired door at the east lobby end; the uppermost wing floor remains brick and fenestrated above the lobby.
photo_sources.limits: Lobby curvature, stair route, and door dimensions remain interpretive.

For the map overlay, invert that approximation, then project WGS84 into EPSG:3857 and map using the exact export extent above.
registration.drawn_features: Purdue GIS FID 873 composite envelope (red), north SDAC roof seam trace (yellow), visible low-roof traces (lime east/southeast and magenta west/northwest), and existing arena roof circle (cyan).
registration.method: Visual overlay only. No georeferenced façade control points, fit optimization, or survey residual were claimed. Source ring remains the composite campus footprint, not individual surveyed additions.
